ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer-mid sections of both lobes. A central dark-intensity Y-shaped region extends from the peduncle through the notch. Small dark-intensity focal spots are distributed sparsely within the white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with 10-15 distinct peaks per lobe; serrations are more pronounced on the outer distal edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips, with a smooth upward concave sweep on the leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple low-intensity circular pixel clusters on the mid-left lobe and a denser cluster of dark spots on the inner-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible as horizontal marks on the outer-left lobe and fine diagonal scratches on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of linear rake-like marks on the left lobe and minor structural irregularities on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular reflections and water spray noise partially occlude the central fluke region and right inner lobe surface.
